scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill \$(jobs -p)" EXIT; bun build viewer.ts --outfile viewer.js --watch & bun --watch server.js "$@" & wait' dev
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test tests/server.test.js && node --test --test-global-setup=tests/global-browser-setup.ts --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 "tests/**/*.test.ts" "*.test.ts" "scripts/**/*.test.ts"
